Class Controller

java.lang.Object
pl.polsl.bustimetable.controller.Controller
public class Controller extends Object
Controller responsible for managing bus stops and handling user commands. Connects the model with the window.
Version:
1.2
Author:
Bartosz Dyba

    • showBusStopTimetable

      public Object[][] showBusStopTimetable(String name)
      Creates new 2D table with rows equal to number of bus lines at the given bus stop and two columns (bus line | times of departure). Then it inputs bus lines and their time of departure to this 2D table. AI-assisted code: With complexity of javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel, AI helped create the code to prepare data for a JTable in Swing.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of bus stop timetable to show
      Returns:
      2D table data of bus lines with their times of departure or null if the bus stop does not exist

    • showBusStops

      public StringBuilder showBusStops()
      Creates a list of all bus stop names. Uses StringBuilder to place each bus stop name under the other. AI-assisted code: As being new to java AI helped create for loop that iterates through the busStops list.
      Returns:
      StringBuilder to correctly show in GUI
